auditory_discrimination.label: Auditory discrimination
auditory_discrimination.title: Distinguish two sounds
auditory_discrimination.objective: Help the child distinguish the target sounds.
auditory_discrimination.instruction: Play or pronounce the sounds, then ask the child to choose the correct answer.
auditory_discrimination.action: Ask the child to listen and choose
auditory_discrimination.hint: Repeat both sounds slowly without revealing the answer.

phoneme_grapheme_matching.label: Sound and letter
phoneme_grapheme_matching.title: Match the sound to the letter
phoneme_grapheme_matching.objective: Connect an Arabic sound with its written form.
phoneme_grapheme_matching.instruction: Pronounce the target sound, then ask the child to touch the matching letter.
phoneme_grapheme_matching.action: Pronounce the sound, then ask for the letter
phoneme_grapheme_matching.hint: Repeat the sound and draw attention to the letter shape.

syllable_ordering.label: Syllable order
syllable_ordering.title: Put the syllables in order
syllable_ordering.objective: Build the word in the correct sequence.
syllable_ordering.instruction: Ask the child to arrange the syllables to form the Arabic word.
syllable_ordering.action: Ask the child to order the syllables
syllable_ordering.hint: Pronounce the word slowly, one syllable at a time.

missing_letter.label: Missing letter
missing_letter.title: Find the missing letter
missing_letter.instruction: Ask the child to identify the missing letter in the word.
missing_letter.action: Ask the child to find the missing letter
missing_letter.hint: Ask the child to read the word slowly and observe the empty position.

letter_ordering.label: Letter order
letter_ordering.title: Put the letters in order
letter_ordering.objective: Build the Arabic word without repetition.
letter_ordering.instruction: Ask the child to arrange the letters to form the word.
letter_ordering.action: Ask the child to build the word
letter_ordering.hint: Pronounce the word slowly while keeping the answer hidden.

extra_phoneme_detection.label: Extra sound
extra_phoneme_detection.title: Identify the added sound
extra_phoneme_detection.objective: Find the segment that was added.
extra_phoneme_detection.instruction: Pronounce both forms, then ask the child to identify the extra sound.
extra_phoneme_detection.action: Ask the child to compare and choose
extra_phoneme_detection.hint: Repeat both forms and emphasize their difference.

guided_reading.label: Guided reading
guided_reading.title: Read a minimal pair
guided_reading.objective: Support accurate reading while preserving sound order.
guided_reading.instruction: Ask the child to read both Arabic words aloud.
guided_reading.action: Ask the child to read aloud
guided_reading.hint: Allow enough time and repeat the instruction calmly.

aiModal.title: AI Acoustic Analysis
aiModal.visualNote: Decorative waiting animation. It does not display the child's audio signal.

checking.label: Preparing recordings
checking.message: Checking that all 15 local recordings are ready for the grouped request.

sending.label: Sending 15 recordings
sending.message: The secure grouped request is being sent to FastAPI and Modal.

analyzing.label: AI Acoustic Analysis
analyzing.message: Modal Acoustic AI is processing the grouped recordings. No reliable percentage is available.

receiving.label: Receiving results
receiving.message: The analysis response has arrived and is being checked.

preparing.label: Preparing the educational review
preparing.message: The received candidates are being organized for companion review.

success.title: Analysis completed
success.message: The results were received. The educational review is opening.

error.title: The analysis could not be completed
error.message: The 15 local recordings are preserved. You can retry without recording them again.

timeout.title: The browser stopped waiting
timeout.message: No response was received within the waiting period. Remote processing may still continue; the 15 local recordings remain preserved.

analyzed.title: Words analyzed
analyzed.description: Number of recordings processed during this session.
analyzed.context: An analyzed recording is not automatically a confirmed difficulty.

candidates.title: Candidate differences
candidates.description: Acoustic differences suggested automatically by the AI model.
candidates.context: A companion must review every candidate.

affected.title: Words with candidates
affected.description: Number of words containing at least one candidate difference.
affected.context: This value does not measure severity.

uncertain.title: Uncertain analyses
uncertain.description: Recordings for which the acoustic result cannot be used confidently.
uncertain.context: Repeat or review these recordings before drawing a conclusion.

review.typeHelp: Choose the educational category that best matches the reviewed reading.
review.decisionHelp: Confirm or reject this AI candidate after listening and reviewing the word.

errors.omission: A target sound may not have been pronounced. This remains a candidate until the companion confirms it.
errors.insertion: A sound not present in the target word may have been added.
errors.inversion: The order of sounds or syllables may have changed during reading.
errors.consonant_substitution: One consonant sound may have been pronounced in place of another.
errors.short_vowel_confusion: A short vowel difference may be present and requires contextual review.
errors.long_vowel_confusion: A vowel-length difference may be present and requires contextual review.

progress.description: Educational estimate based on the child's previous activity results; it is not a medical diagnosis.
progress.empty: Progress estimates will appear after completed activities.

results.reviewExplanation: AI observations are acoustic candidates. Only the companion's explicit validation records a human-confirmed observation.
